details: The United States and Iran have reportedly paused their mutual military strikes over the weekend, ending a nearly two-week period of escalating hostilities. This de-escalation followed reports of diplomatic efforts and advice from military officials to President Trump to halt the bombing campaign. The immediate market reaction saw oil prices tumble by approximately 4-5%, with Brent crude falling to around $92 per barrel, as hopes for a diplomatic solution and resumed shipping in the Strait of Hormuz increased. In response to the reduced geopolitical risk, Bitcoin saw a modest rise of about 0.9% to roughly $65,193, while Ethereum climbed by 1.9% to around $1,948. This shift indicates a temporary "risk-on" sentiment in the broader financial markets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: US and Iran Pause Strikes, Easing Tensions and Boosting Crypto
